---
name: {{name}}-ship
description: Ship a reviewed {{name}} item to the base branch. Use when the user says ship, land or merge it.
---
<!-- {{name}}-managed: generated by `{{cmd}} sync`; edits are overwritten -->
Only the user ships. Run `{{cmd}} review` and confirm the user is satisfied, then run
`{{cmd}} ship` (the user confirms it). Push only if the user asks.
Afterwards run `{{cmd}} tidy` to remove the item's local branch and worktree; run
`{{cmd}} tidy --remote` (it deletes remote branches) only when the user asks.
